subject: Request: service credit waiver and pricing concession
messages:
From: Katie O'Neill <katie@olivethera.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-03-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Request: service credit waiver and pricing concession

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile on the embedding pipeline looks promising for our cohort scoring use case. We are in the final stages of procurement but have two items blocking approval from our legal and procurement teams: one commercial and one SLA-related.

1) Commercial: We need a temporary onboarding concession (one-time credit) to offset engineering ramp and data migration costs. Our procurement target is a $35k credit applied on first invoice.
2) SLA: Our security team is asking if you can accept a short-term, lowered uptime target for the first 6 months while we complete the integration (99.90% instead of the standard 99.99%) and to waive service credits tied to that degraded target for the pilot window.

Please let me know if these two items are workable — we are ready to sign once terms are cleared. I attached a draft SOW for context.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (attachment)

Best,
Katie
Katie O'Neill
Head of Procurement, Olive Therapeutics
Katie.O@olivethera.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Katie O'Neill <katie@olivethera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-15 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service credit waiver and pricing concession

Katie —

Appreciate the clear outline. We can move quickly on this. High-level response:
- Commercial credit: deal desk can provision a one-time onboarding credit. I will propose $40k to cover migration and incentivize a Q2 close.
- SLA carveout: we can support a temporary uptime tolerance for an initial 6-month pilot if it is documented as a pilot/limited-scope clause and we include an operational remediation plan (weekly runbooks + joint playbook). We cannot permanently change the MA.

Next steps: I am routing to our deal desk and need exec sign-off for the above concessions (commercial + SLA language). Can Marissa and Ben please confirm the recommended credit cap and any precedent concerns? If you can share a short paragraph on why you need the 99.90% for six months (team availability/maintenance windows), that helps our legal and reliability review.

I attached a one-page proposal summary.

Attachments: proposal_summary.pdf (attachment)

Thanks — talk soon
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-03-16 08:17 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: service credit waiver and pricing concession — request for exec clearance

Team — forwarding Olive Therapeutics' ask. Quick summary and recommendation below.

---- Original message ----
On 2025-03-15 09:12 -0700, Katie O'Neill <katie@olivethera.com> wrote:
> (see attachment SOW_v1.pdf)
>
> Procurement asks for a $35k onboarding credit and a 6-month pilot where uptime is 99.90% with waived service credits for that pilot window.

Why this matters: Olive is a strategic target in our healthcare vertical — large volumes of embeddings, potential multi-region expansion, and strong reference value. They are committed to a 24-month initial term if we can clear these items.

Recommended ask to Exec/Deal Desk:
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit, capped at $40,000 (covers their ask and small buffer).
- Approve a temporary SLA carveout: document as a 6-month pilot with explicit remediation checkpoints and no permanent MA change. Waive credits during pilot only.
- Require legal to insert a pilot clause and require Olive to sign an operational runbook acceptance.

Risks / precedents:
- Waiving credits sets a precedent — recommend we limit approvals to strategic targets and log in deal precedent register.
- Operational exposure during pilot; reliability must sign off on remediation plan.

Attachments: deal_scorecard.xlsx (deal economics + ARR cadence)

Request: Jonas — can you provide quick exec clearance? Marissa/Ben — any commercial guardrails we should add? I need a response by EOD Monday so we can keep their procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Rachel
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-17 15:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: service credit waiver and pricing concession — request for exec clearance

Approve with conditions.

Conditions to approve:
1) Cap onboarding credit at $40,000 total and bill as a contra on the first invoice. No retroactive increases.
2) SLA carveout allowed for a six-month pilot only; service credits waived during pilot. Post-pilot we revert to standard SLA with a 30-day remediation notice if targets not met.
3) Legal must insert a pilot clause that explicitly states: pilot scope, metrics, rollback path, and that no MA term is permanently amended. Legal to sign off on SLA redline (cc'd).
4) Reliability/operations to confirm the joint runbook and remediation checkpoints before countersignature.
5) No other concessions (pricing or extended credits) without VP sales sign-off.

Jonas Weber
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

(Reply: I want this recorded as a precedent — Marissa please add to the carveout register and tag finance for the credit booking rules.)
